description: Install dependencies and verify the project builds cleanly with TypeScript and Vite
steps: Run npx tsc --noEmit to verify TypeScript compiles without errors
Run npx vite build to verify the project bundles correctly
verification: npx vite build exits with code 0
findings: Node.js 20.19.0 needed to be installed (system had Node 18 from Amazon Linux repo, but Vite 7 requires Node 20+). Downloaded from nodejs.org. npm install, tsc --noEmit, and vite build all pass cleanly.
